sn22.150:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn22.150:1.4: rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.8: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn22.150:1.12: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.150:1.14: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn22.150:1.21: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn22.150:1.23: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
